LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 10.3.1 PREPOSITIONS (NEXT TO, AROUND, NEAR, BY, ALONG, AFTER, UNDER)

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions (next to, around, near, by, along, after, under)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions (next to, around, near, by, along, after, under), part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Where are different things in the classroom placed? 2. Where do you keep different things at home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Identify the target prepositions (next to, around, near, by, along, after, under) in a written or audio text,

2. Describe the positions of different objects in the classroom, at school or home.

3. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.

4. Listen to and answer oral questions related to prepositions in a story/poems/song,

5. Place objects at different points in relation to the prepositions learnt and ask their peers to use suitable prepositions to 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Identify the target prepositions (next to, around, near, by, along, after, under) in a written or audio text,
2. Describe the positions of different objects in the classroom, at school or home.
3. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.
4. Listen to and answer oral questions related to prepositions in a story/poems/song,
5. Place objects at different points in relation to the prepositions learnt and ask their peers to use suitable prepositions to 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 10.3.1 Prepositions (next to, around, near, by, along, after, under) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs
